STILLROOT'S SONG   |   PLAYER HANDOUT

The lucid crossing

Secure a place to return to.

Tie the red cord to something real. Lay it across your wrists; it must not bind you.

Keep an ordinary light burning.

Each willing participant speaks one remembered truth. It need not be a secret or a painful one.

Close your eyes, sleep, trance or grow still. Hold the cord. Follow the door that opens.

The dream does not restore spent strength. Wounds suffered there can reach the waking body. A return is possible at the marked threshold if you can keep it undisturbed for a minute.

No one enters because another person consented for them.
